title: High-Frequency Trading & Market Data Processing (PYTH_193_S1 to PYTH_193_S8)

slides.title: Order Book Architecture
slides.prompt: Trading engines maintain limit order books using bid/ask price trees and execution queues to match buy and sell orders with sub-millisecond latency.
slides.codeSnippet:

slides.title: Min-Heap Insertion for Asks
slides.prompt: Fill in the standard Python heapq function used to insert a new ask order into a priority queue.

slides.title: Bid-Ask Spread Definition
slides.prompt: What does the bid-ask spread represent in a limit order book?
options: The price difference between the lowest available ask price and the highest available bid price
The total number of orders submitted to an exchange in one second
The percentage fee charged by the broker on market transactions
The daily price range between market open and market close
slides.correctAnswer: The price difference between the lowest available ask price and the highest available bid price

slides.title: Zero-Copy Struct Unpacking
slides.prompt: Fill in the standard library module used to parse high-frequency binary market data feeds without memory overhead.

slides.title: FIX Protocol (Financial Information eXchange)
slides.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the FIX protocol in algorithmic trading infrastructure?
options: Standardized messaging protocol for electronic trade order submission, execution reports, and market data
Database query language for historical stock market price charts
Cryptographic hashing algorithm for blockchain transactions
Python web framework for financial analytics dashboards
slides.correctAnswer: Standardized messaging protocol for electronic trade order submission, execution reports, and market data

slides.title: Circular Buffer Ring Queues
slides.prompt: Fill in the collections class used for fixed-size lock-free memory buffers in streaming tick processors.

slides.title: Slippage in Market Orders
slides.prompt: What causes execution 'slippage' when executing large market orders?
options: The order consumes available liquidity across multiple price levels in the order book, executing at progressively worse prices
The broker cancels the order due to low account balance
The exchange network connection experiences latency spikes
The stock trading symbol is changed mid-transaction
slides.correctAnswer: The order consumes available liquidity across multiple price levels in the order book, executing at progressively worse prices

slides.title: Calculating Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP)
slides.prompt: Fill in the expression parameter formula used to compute VWAP in market data aggregations.
